operator_class.description: Module + class name of the operator

retry_delay.description: Delay before a retry, as "<seconds> seconds", before retry_exponential_backoff and max_retry_delay apply.

task_group.description: The task's own task group, absent for a task in no group. It never describes a loop, even when the group is one: task.loop does, for every task in a loop.

group_id.description: Id of the group without the ids of its parent groups.

full_group_id.description: Full id of the group, with the ids of its parent groups, as task.loop.group_id and the keys of AirflowJobFacet.taskGroups name groups. A task sits directly in its loop when it equals task.loop.group_id.

TaskLoop.description: The loop the task runs in (Airflow 3.4+), whether the task sits directly in the loop or in a task group inside it. Absent outside a loop. taskInstance.loop tells which iteration the event comes from.

group_id.description: Full group id of the loop, including the ids of its parent groups.

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations of the loop.

has_until.description: Whether the loop has an until condition that can stop it before max_iterations.

gate_task_id.description: Id of the loop's gate, the task that ends each iteration and decides whether the loop goes on.

terminal_task_id.description: Id of the last task of the loop body, whose result the gate and the next iteration read.

id.description: UUID of this attempt (Airflow 3+). Every try, and every task instance a clear creates again, gets a new one.

map_index.description: Position in a mapped task's expansion. Absent for a task that isn't mapped.

rendered_map_index.description: Label of the mapped instance, rendered from the task's map_index_template. Absent when the task isn't mapped or renders no label.

dag_version_id.description: Id of the Dag version the attempt runs (Airflow 3+), which can differ from the Dag run's when the task instance was cleared to run on another version.

dag_bundle_name.description: Name of the Dag bundle the attempt runs from (Airflow 3+).

dag_bundle_version.description: Version of the Dag bundle the attempt runs from (Airflow 3+). Absent for a bundle without versions.

expanded_ti_count.description: Number of live instances in the mapped task's expansion (Airflow 3.4+), counted within the loop iteration inside a loop. Absent for a task that isn't mapped.

region_id.description: Id of the region (one execution of a loop or of a mapped task's expansion) the task instance belongs to (Airflow 3.4+). Shared by the task instances of that region. For a mapped task it is its expansion's, see loop.region_id for the loop's. Absent for a task that is neither mapped nor in a loop.

region_index.description: Position inside the region (Airflow 3.4+): the iteration for a task in a loop that isn't mapped, the map index for a mapped task. Together with dag_id, the Dag run's run_id, task_id, region_id and try_number it identifies one attempt. Absent with region_id.

try_number.description: Try of the task instance, counted per region_id and region_index.

max_tries.description: Last try_number that can be retried on failure. Equals the task's retries until the task instance is cleared, which sets it to the last try_number plus retries.

state.description: State of the task instance when the event is sent, e.g. running on START, success or skipped on COMPLETE, and up_for_retry or failed on FAIL. A FAIL with up_for_retry is retried, and one with failed is final unless the task instance is cleared. A FAIL with restarting comes from a try that a clear stopped, and the task runs again.

TaskInstanceLoop.description: The iteration of the loop the event comes from (Airflow 3.4+), task.loop being that loop. Absent outside a loop. Fields that can't be known are left out.

region_id.description: Id of the loop region holding the iteration, shared by every task instance of that pass of the loop, mapped ones included.

trajectory.description: 1 for the loop's original region, and one more for each fork of it. Clearing a loop gate with the later iterations forks the loop region, and the higher trajectory is the current one.

forked_from_region_id.description: Id of the previous loop region of the chain this fork extends. Absent for the original region. The fork replaces the iterations from resumes_from_index on, which earlier regions of the chain can hold too.

resumes_from_index.description: First iteration the fork holds. Absent for the original region, which holds them from 1.

decision.description: Decision of a loop gate, on its COMPLETE or FAIL event only. A FAIL with stop false at the last iteration means the loop's until was still false at task.loop.max_iterations.

stop.description: Whether the gate stopped the loop.

reason.description: Reason given by until, if any.
